svg.title: (FST7)–(FST8) place the regular and forced parts within the allowances (AB12) at the clock value x = bβN, on the shooting band x/2 ≤β ≤2x, with thresholds uniform in N and p at a fixed stage. The forced estimate uses only the lower endpoint: βθ2 ≥M(z)2/2. The regular estimate uses the upper endpoint: βθ5 ≤2x−3/2M(z)5. The dictionaries of supports and flag predicates are independent of β; regular entries are linear in β and forced entries are exponentials of bounded finite-volume functions times fixed eligibility indicators. Hence the startup family is a continuous curve of represented states with a fixed layout, which is exactly the input required by the shooting argument. The exactness class is exact recovery (an identity of densities), together with a bound that places the exact representative in the activity ball.
